sources.title: Codex CLI 0.154.0 release
sources.finding: The stable release includes managed app-server work on Windows and removes the deprecated mcp-server entrypoint.
sources.decision: Use installed 0.154.0 documented interfaces; do not revive a removed entrypoint or assume a release note proves this desktop service healthy.

sources.title: Codex Python SDK 0.154.0
sources.finding: The release notes distinguish external content from user authorization and expose saved-history reads.
sources.decision: Keep source-content authority separate; do not treat an external activation summary as a new blanket permission source.

sources.title: Codex App Server
sources.finding: Stored summaries can be listed; the current documentation says full-history reads and turn pagination for paginated records fail closed until supported.
sources.decision: Distinguish discovery from current-control availability. Preserve unsupported-history missingness and use the exact current native task surface first.

sources.title: MCP stdio binding 2026-07-28
sources.finding: The documented stdio lifecycle includes closing input and terminating an owned child if necessary.
sources.decision: An owned read-only diagnostic child can be cleaned up without treating it as the managed desktop daemon or delivery proof.

sources.title: Node.js 24.18.0 release
sources.finding: The installed runtime belongs to the supported LTS line; the specific release page dates it to 23 June 2026.
sources.decision: Record the exact runtime and keep version provenance distinct from the claim that every installed tool is latest.

sources.title: Managing usage with GPT-6 Astra
sources.finding: Usage depends on task, model and settings; plan message counts are estimates rather than fixed rates.
sources.decision: Retain Hamish token-ratio observations as reported scenarios, use current account usage for this run, and avoid claiming measured savings from the weighted roster.

sources.title: Google CLI transition notice
sources.finding: Google describes a consumer transition from Gemini CLI to Antigravity CLI with a June 2026 cutoff.
sources.decision: Keep older Journey Gemini CLI commands historical and review the actual account and product before any future integration.

sources.title: Google managed agent platform
sources.finding: The older Agent Engine Memory Bank documentation URL redirects to the current managed agent platform.
sources.decision: Do not copy stale cloud endpoints or provision infrastructure from an older Journey document; local event schemas remain provider-neutral.

sources.title: Anthropic building effective agents
sources.finding: The engineering guidance distinguishes predictable workflows from model-directed agents and emphasizes simple composable patterns.
sources.decision: Use deterministic workflow and simulation modules for this phase; no unrequested multi-agent activation is needed.

sources.title: NVIDIA and Palantir supply-chain announcement
sources.finding: The September 10 announcement discusses Nemotron models and Vera Rubin infrastructure in a supply-chain context.
sources.decision: Treat hardware and vendor capability announcements as external context, not evidence of available local GPU capacity or a completed GHC deployment.

sources.title: Matt Shumer Unreal Engine simulation post
sources.finding: The September 4 post describes an Unreal Engine world with Astra-powered characters cooperating to survive. The post text and embedded video presence were observed in the browser.
sources.decision: Use as design inspiration for inspectable cooperation, bounded resources and dialogue events. Video behavior, sound and implementation were not independently verified; no media file was created.
